event:
I verified the finding: the AON timer branch of `ottf_handle_irq` only calls `LOG_ERROR` and returns `true`. It has no `CHECK` or other fail call. A bark interrupt therefore cannot fail the test there, even though the plan says the handler should fail the test.

The alert handler branch of the same function does use `CHECK`, but that covers the escalation state, not the AON timer interrupt.

I only read lines 60–210 of `sw/device/tests/aon_timer_wdog_lc_escalate_test.c`. I did not read the rest of the test, so I did not look for another place that would catch a bark interrupt.

The verdict has been submitted and accepted.
